title: Register update in the power loop
statement: Let $C,e,B\in\mathbb{N}$, let $m,o\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, let $f$ map finite bit strings to finite bit strings, let $h$ be a finite bit string, let $k$ be an element of the finite set of natural numbers below $e+2$, and let $v$ be a vector of fourteen natural-number registers. Suppose every register value is at most $B$, registers $6,10,11$ are zero, register $8$ is positive, and, with $F=2C+3$ if $o$ is true and $F=C$ otherwise, both $v(7)v(8)^{k}$ and $Fv(7)v(8)^{k}$ are at most $B$. Then there is a run from the power-loop state with flags $o,k$, register vector $v$, and no answer yet, to length bound if $o$ is false and tail test if $o$ is true. Every configuration before the endpoint satisfies the program's admissibility condition and has all register values at most $B$; at the endpoint register $7$ is $Fv(7)v(8)^k$, and every other register retains its initial value.

replaced:
Let $C,e,B\in\mathbb N$, let
$\mathrm{mode},\mathrm{outer}\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, let $f$ be a function
from finite bit strings to finite bit strings, let $h$ be a finite bit string, let
$k<e+2$, and let $v$ assign a natural number to each of fourteen registers. Suppose
every register value is at most $B$, registers $6$, $10$, and $11$ contain zero,
register $8$ is positive, and both $v(7)v(8)^k$ and $F(v(7)v(8)^k)$ are at most $B$,
where $F=C$ when $\mathrm{outer}$ is false and $F=2C+3$ when it is true. Then the
specified register program can run from its power-loop state indexed by $\mathrm{outer}$
and $k$, with register vector $v$ and no answer yet, to the length-bound state when
$\mathrm{outer}$ is false or the tail-check state when it is true; at that point
register $7$ contains $F(v(7)v(8)^k)$ and every other register retains its initial
value. Every configuration before that endpoint satisfies the program's
instruction-specific admissibility conditions, and all register values in those
configurations are at most $B$.
